boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented Belknap-campus places for studying, creating, recreation, student services, and events.

cards.title: Set up at Ekstrom Library
cards.subtitle: Belknap Campus • study space
cards.notes: Use the library’s individual or collaborative spaces for a focused work session, then reserve a study room through the library system when needed.
cards.short_summary: A central academic space with study rooms and technology.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL describes Ekstrom Library as a central student-life space, open 24/5 during the semester, with modern spaces supporting group projects and individual study.
cards.source_title: Academic Support | University of Louisville Academic Catalogs
cards.access_notes: Library access and room reservations follow University Libraries policies; check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Meet up at the SAC
cards.subtitle: 2100 South Floyd Street • Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Use the lounges or event areas as a meeting point, and check the building’s student-services offices when you need campus involvement support.
cards.short_summary: The Belknap hub for dining, lounges, events, and student services.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL calls the Swain Student Activities Center the main hub for student life on the Belknap campus and lists dining, event spaces, lounges, and student-activity offices there.
cards.source_title: Student Activities Center – About Us | Student Services
cards.access_notes: Building hours listed by UofL are Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–11 p.m. and weekends 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; event rooms may require reservation.

cards.title: Check the Red Barn program calendar
cards.subtitle: Belknap Campus • Student Activities Center venue
cards.notes: Look for a student-facing concert, movie, cookout, meeting, or social program; contact Student Involvement if your group needs to reserve the venue.
cards.short_summary: A historic multi-purpose venue for campus programs and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL says the Red Barn hosts concerts, movies, cookouts, meetings, and other social and administrative events, and is available for use by students and other interested parties.
cards.source_title: Student Activities Center - George J. Howe Red Barn | Student Services
cards.access_notes: Programs and reservation availability vary; contact the Office of Student Involvement for venue information.

cards.title: Plan an active break at the Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Belknap Campus • Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Bring a workout, court, or indoor recreation plan and review Campus Recreation membership and reservation details before you go.
cards.short_summary: A 128,000-square-foot recreation facility with courts, fitness studios, and training areas.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL lists six basketball courts, group fitness studios, strength-training areas, a turf field, racquetball/squash courts, and other recreation features at the Student Recreation Center.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on current Campus Recreation membership or eligibility; some spaces can be reserved by members.

cards.title: Connect through the Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: Belknap Village North • student activities and support
cards.notes: Check the center’s programs and affiliated organizations when looking for mentoring, leadership opportunities, or campus-community connections.
cards.short_summary: A campus support and student-activities destination in Belknap Village North.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL identifies the Cultural Center’s primary use as administrative and student activities/support; its programming includes academic engagement, development, mentor support, and student-organization involvement.
cards.source_title: Parish LLC | University Housing & the Resident Experience
cards.access_notes: The Cultural Center is housed inside Belknap Village North; contact the center for current program and visitor details.

cards.title: See what is on view at Schneider Hall
cards.subtitle: Belknap Campus • Department of Fine Arts
cards.notes: Review the scheduled exhibition hours, then visit the galleries to see current student, faculty, or visiting work alongside the art-school studios.
cards.short_summary: Department of Fine Arts galleries within a building of studios and art resources.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL describes Schneider Hall Galleries as a central exhibition hub for Fine Arts on Belknap Campus and says the building contains studios, classrooms, labs, galleries, and the Bridwell Art Library.
cards.source_title: Schneider Hall Galleries | College of Arts & Sciences
cards.access_notes: Galleries are open during scheduled exhibition hours and special events; confirm the current exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Pair a class break with the Speed
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Belknap Campus • 2035 South Third Street
cards.notes: Check the museum’s current exhibitions and visitor information, then use the nearby campus location for an art-focused break between commitments.
cards.short_summary: Kentucky’s oldest and largest art museum sits next to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL’s Hite Institute states that the Speed Art Museum, Kentucky’s oldest and largest art museum, is located next to the university campus and offers interactive exhibits and outdoor spaces.
cards.source_title: The Speed Art Museum — Hite Institute of Art and Design | Department of Art and Design
cards.access_notes: The museum is adjacent to campus; confirm current gallery hours, exhibitions, and admission policies directly with the museum.

cards.title: Use the Ville Grill as a meal stop
cards.subtitle: Third Street and Brandeis Avenue • Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Check the day’s dining information before heading over, and use the all-you-care-to-eat dining hall for a sit-down meal near campus housing.
cards.short_summary: A trayless, all-you-care-to-eat campus dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL Sustainability identifies The Ville Grill at Third Street and Brandeis Avenue as an all-you-care-to-eat dining hall open to students, employees, and the public.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires payment or an applicable meal plan; check UofL Dining for current menus and service details.

cards.title: Find the Foucault pendulum in Grawemeyer Hall
cards.subtitle: Grawemeyer Hall • Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Make a short science stop at the named pendulum, then pair it with a walk through the central academic buildings on Belknap Campus.
cards.short_summary: A named astronomy point of interest inside Grawemeyer Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Louisville Department of Physics and Astronomy lists the Grawemeyer Hall Foucault Pendulum among its Belknap Campus educational sites.
cards.source_title: Astronomy and Astrophysics Research and Education
cards.access_notes: Located in an academic building; follow building access rules and confirm access when classes or events are in session.

cards.title: Look for the Natural Science solar telescope
cards.subtitle: Natural Science Building • Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Locate this named astronomy feature during a daytime campus walk, and consult the department’s educational resources for related astronomy programming.
cards.short_summary: A named campus astronomy feature associated with the Physics and Astronomy department.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Louisville Department of Physics and Astronomy lists the Natural Science Building solar telescope among its Belknap Campus educational sites.
cards.source_title: Astronomy and Astrophysics Research and Education
cards.access_notes: Located in an academic building; follow posted directions and building-access rules, and do not use equipment without authorization.
